title: OpenMesh: Code for the OpenMesh Wireless Signal Dataset
description: Code to download, read, fetch reference data for, and analyse the OpenMesh wireless signal dataset (commercial microwave links of the NYC Mesh community network, New York City): readers for the v1 (ESSD) and v2 (OpenMesh 2.0.0) records, fetchers for MRMS and KOKX radar, ASOS, GHCN-Daily and Weather Underground PWS data, converters to OpenSense netCDF, and tutorial notebooks.
